mechanism: Diclofenac may increase perphenazine levels through CYP450 inhibition (primarily CYP2D6 and CYP3A4), and both drugs can cause CNS depression and increase risk of anticholinergic effects and photosensitivity.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine adverse effects (sedation, anticholinergic symptoms, dystonia); consider dose adjustment of perphenazine if needed and counsel on photosensitivity precautions.
